graph_domains.name: Margin Protection (cost to price)
graph_domains.note: Every expected source is connected and profiled; agreements, supplier contracts, notices, entry summaries and code reports are in the Drive corpus; the mailbox is connected.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No finance, trade or pricing source connected.

graph_domains.name: Supplier Pass-through and Duty Recovery
graph_domains.note: Clause 9.3 claims, refund states and certificates resolve. Whether a clause was breached is a legal judgement the graph does not make.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No contract terms or trade register connected.

graph_domains.name: Plant and Supplier Change Readiness
graph_domains.note: Code report coverage, capacity and landed cost resolve; the evaluation agency's scheduling is not connected, so inspection timing is a stated indication only.

graph_domains.name: Demand Forecasting
graph_domains.note: No order-book or market feed is connected and realisation history is not elasticity. Volume and 'optimal price' questions are declined.

graph_personas.name: Chief Financial Officer
graph_personas.focus: Asks which families are below target, what moved the margin, how far below the floor, and what the committee can decide.

graph_personas.name: VP Global Sourcing
graph_personas.focus: Asks what suppliers changed, whether notices were valid, what can be claimed back, and how much steel cover there is.

graph_personas.name: Pricing Director
graph_personas.focus: Asks whether past increases covered cost, which agreements limit repricing, and what the next cycle needs.

graph_personas.name: FP&A Manager
graph_personas.focus: Asks for the bridge by family, landed cost by source, the forecast against plan and the increase that holds the floor.

graph_personas.name: National Accounts Director
graph_personas.focus: Asks what each national account can bear, what the cost justification supports, and what builder programs owe.

graph_personas.name: Trade Compliance Manager
graph_personas.focus: Asks what duty was paid, what is recoverable and in what state, and which entries lack evidence.

graph_personas.name: Product Engineer
graph_personas.focus: Asks which reports list a plant, when an inspection is, and whether a line can ship.

graph_use_case_templates.name: Margin Protection (cost to price)
graph_use_case_templates.description: One model over certified margin, purchasing, customs, pricing agreements, steel and code reports, so a margin question resolves once - with the clause, the entry or the record that evidences it.

graph_metrics.name: Gross margin by family
graph_metrics.definition: GM = (net sales − cost of sales) ÷ net sales per family per certified month; cost of sales split into steel, duty, freight, conversion and other. Open months are never read.

graph_metrics.name: Landed cost per pound
graph_metrics.definition: Landed = supplier price + duty at the entry-date rate + inbound freight (+ conversion where made), ÷ net weight, per source.

graph_metrics.name: Price realisation
graph_metrics.definition: Realisation = net invoice price ÷ list price in force, per channel and family. A list increase is not realised until the ratio holds.

graph_metrics.name: Tariff cost per family
graph_metrics.definition: Duty recognised in cost of sales per family as inventory turns; never equal to entries filed in the month.

graph_metrics.name: Recoverable pass-through
graph_metrics.definition: Supplier's share of new duties under a pass-through clause, on the quarter's entries, within the claim window and cap. Waived outside the window.

graph_metrics.name: Weeks of steel cover
graph_metrics.definition: Weeks = tons on hand ÷ trailing 8-week consumption, per grade. Tons on order are shown separately, never added.

graph_metrics.name: Rebate accrual
graph_metrics.definition: Accrual = confirmed sell-through × the tier reached year to date. A month without a dealer file is not confirmed and is never estimated.

graph_metrics.name: Recoverable duty
graph_metrics.definition: IEEPA duty on entries to 20 Feb 2026, by state: refunded, claimed, unclaimed. Section 301 and 232 are never recoverable. States are never summed as cash.

graph_metrics.name: Protected revenue share
graph_metrics.definition: Share of net sales under agreements whose price cannot change before a stated date; capped shares shown separately.

graph_metrics.name: Cost coverage ratio
graph_metrics.definition: Coverage = qualifying cost increase (per the agreement's clause) ÷ revenue effect of a price increase, per agreement.

graph_metrics.name: Notice-window days remaining
graph_metrics.definition: Days from today to a notice or claim deadline set by a clause (notice period, claim window, justification period).

graph_metrics.name: Code-report plant coverage
graph_metrics.definition: Share of a family's reports that list a plant as a manufacturing location. Requested or scheduled is not coverage.

graph_answer_formats.name: Gap to target
graph_answer_formats.format: table by family with target, gap and prior quarter; bar of gaps

graph_answer_formats.name: Bridge
graph_answer_formats.format: metric row + driver bar + evidence per driver; unattributed remainder stated

graph_answer_formats.name: Terms table
graph_answer_formats.format: one row per agreement or contract with the clause, limit, notice and date

graph_answer_formats.name: Established vs open
graph_answer_formats.format: two tables: dated facts with sources, open questions with owners

graph_answer_formats.name: Lines evaluated
graph_answer_formats.format: included · excluded · cannot evaluate, each with its rule

graph_answer_formats.name: By state
graph_answer_formats.format: metric row per state + table of exceptions; never a total

graph_answer_formats.name: Gates
graph_answer_formats.format: one row per gate with status, owner and evidence

graph_answer_formats.name: Levers and floor
graph_answer_formats.format: cases table: extra cost, gap to ceiling, increase needed

graph_answer_formats.name: Provenance table
graph_answer_formats.format: every figure with dataset, basis and as-of

graph_answer_formats.name: Decline with alternative
graph_answer_formats.format: reason for declining + what can be answered instead
